controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Published preliminary ellipsoid using minimum full dimensions from Stardust flyby images. It does not reproduce the observed angular outline or establish a complete global shape. Full approximation dimensions: 6.6 × 5 × 3.4 km. Arbitrary display pole and meridian. The flyby did not establish a spin pole or current surface longitude; the display orientation is not a measured attitude. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
controls.title: Stardust minimum-size approximation
